text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On our way back from an outing with Yamanin Zephyr, a corner of the shopping district was bustling with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's quite vibrant and blooming.
Almost like a fresh breeze blowing through.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, that inn is...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I have heard that it is a place surrounded by beautiful mountains, where a pleasant, blessed breeze blows.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The forest creatures... Small animals, little birds, too.
I hear many of them live here.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Fufu, indeed. Let's believe this encounter is an auspicious wind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
we bought daily necessities, got lottery tickets――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr turned the handle of the raffle drum!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"My, I'm astonished.
To think it would actually hit the mark."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"A summer breeze in winter, a winter gale in summer...
Hehe, life certainly has a way of surprising us."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what shall we do?
During the balmy spring breeze, or the autumn breeze...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If possible, I would prefer a season where we can spend our time
gently and calmly, like a slow-moving cloud, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Things are hectic right now with training and races.
Squeezing in a trip might just make her
even more exhausted.
choice_data_list: How about putting it away until you calm down?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Until she calms down...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that is true, shall we do so?
It is a rare auspicious wind; let us wait for the favorable breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
It's just like the days spent waiting for the spring east wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to it, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Am I coming along with you, too?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
After all, it was you and I who witnessed that auspicious wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Don't you want to go?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let us depart.
A journey of crisp autumn breezes awaits us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we promised to go on a hot springs trip
together once things settled down.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
First prize...
Just one short, was it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No.
However, the tailwind was more than favorable enough.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Because I felt a breath of divine lightning in my idle, carefree days.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Now, since we have this rare opportunity...
I'd like to enjoy this in the cool breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: If you'd like, would you care to join me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, guided by her, we visited a scenic hilltop with a great view—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Right this way, please.
I've prepared some tea as well.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
—What magnificent red clouds.
Dusk will fall soon. The elm breeze shall blow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While enjoying the view, we shared and ate the hamburg steak together.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Well, looks like I missed the auspicious wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, so many splendid carrots.
They're not easy to come by, are they?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Like a gentle, auspicious breeze,
what lovely roots and leaves.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I can't finish this alone, and even with the two of us, Trainer, it might be a bit too much...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, I just thought of something good.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The next day.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Good morning.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"I left some homemade carrot cake over there.
If you'd like, please have some too, Nature-san."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Zephyr made that huge pile of cakes!?
Whoa, gimme some, gimme some~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr's cooking has such a gentle,
comforting flavor, you know?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
My, such traditional Japanese-sounding words...
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It puts me at ease...
If that's the case, perhaps I shall bring one for Trainer later as well. Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, 3rd prize... It seems the grand prize
was far beyond the eightfold sea breezes.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The lottery wheel is like a windmill.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Even though I know better...
Hehe, it's not good to get my hopes up, is it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, it's quite a twist of fate.
One carrot, please."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Since we have the chance,
shall I whip something up?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, she offered to make dinner
using the carrots, and――

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Simmered carrots and wild greens,
seasonal fish, and white rice.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Let us accept it gratefully.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The two of them savored the gentle flavors of dinner together.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear...
So it's a miss, then?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...No, but whether this wind
becomes a black wind depends on one's heart.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: You shouldn't just stay discouraged.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Until next time.
A new wind shall blow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—That said, Yamanin Zephyr
seemed just a little disheartened.
